name: client-360
description: REQUIRES FIVE claude.ai CONNECTORS, added by each viewer under Settings > Connectors with EXACTLY these names: "Customer 360" (the Salesforce-hosted Customer360 MCP server, a custom connector with the bank's own OAuth client key and secret), "IDB Gateway" (Boom spreads), "Microsoft 365" (inbox), "Experience / nCino" (the credit-memo writeback and ledger: narrative sections, the nFORMS memo document, the approval submit, the notice, and the decision and audit trail) and "AFS" (servicing reads and the servicing workpackage). A SIXTH, "Salesforce Read Backup", is OPTIONAL BUT RECOMMENDED: a second hop serving the same ten Customer 360 reads so the cockpit still shows live figures when the artifact-to-connector relay drops its Salesforce session; reads only, and every write stays on "Customer 360" under the banker's own identity. The cockpit page calls them by name through the viewer's own grant; a differently named connector is invisible to it. Customer 360 Reinvented: an Accenture accelerator: a worklist-first commercial-credit relationship cockpit for C&I bankers, drivable in natural chat. OPENING IT IS INSTANT: the default open hands the banker the canonical published cockpit named in assets/cockpit.json and the page refreshes itself through the viewer's own connectors, lane by lane, with last-good figures marked by their age until the live ones land and a footer line naming any connector that is stale or unreachable. Fetching, assembling and publishing is the explicit rebuild path. Reads the book live from Salesforce (nCino + FSC) via the org-hosted Customer360 MCP server (28 tools: 10 reads plus 8 governed stage/execute write pairs, a second-hop completion tool and one stage-only renewal, per-user OAuth) plus Boom-spread financials, and renders a full React application as an interactive Cowork artifact: needs-action worklist with reason codes, per-account Activity audit trail, exposure & collateral, covenants with effective-challenge validation, relationship graph, whitespace, structural early-warning signals, a page-agnostic AI chat, and a data-gated Client Actions control center. Governed writes follow one discipline: stage the plan, show the org's warnings verbatim, the banker confirms, execute behind a single-use decision token bound to the running identity, verify by re-query. Guided workflows cover a client request becoming a package-anchored loan modification, package-scoped bulk covenant review, package-anchored collateral valuation, service requests, annual reviews, risk rating reviews, new facilities and renewals. Use when a banker asks to open the Customer 360, pull up the relationship view, work the needs-action queue, or act on a client request.
